metadata.title: Noteim
metadata.description: Meeting minutes from voice recordings, built for Vietnamese professionals.

app.redirecting: Taking you to the style guide

styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: Noteim's colours, type and shapes. Every screen may only use what's on this page.

preview.aiAnswer: Ms Lan plans a 50% loan and is worried about rates after the promo period.

styleguide.previewNote: Lotus pink is what you do, electric violet is what the AI does. The Dawn gradient is only for the record button.
styleguide.colorsHint: Codes and contrast are read from the tokens for the current theme.
styleguide.dawnHint: Only for the record button, the live ribbon glow, and the logo.

bg.name: Page
bg.usage: Porcelain in light, night indigo in dark

senText.name: Lotus text
senText.usage: Pink text on surfaces, playing timestamp

styleguide.tagsHint: Always an icon and a word, never colour alone.
styleguide.speakersHint: Assigned in order of appearance. Only for the ribbon, name dots and transcript bars, never for text.
styleguide.speaker: Speaker {index}
styleguide.typeHint: Large headings use Bricolage Grotesque, everything else uses Be Vietnam Pro.
styleguide.sample: Đặng Thị Quỳnh Ngữ, Nguyễn Hữu Phước: thỏa thuận chuyển nhượng 12,5 tỷ
styleguide.typeDesktopNote: From 768px, Display is 44/52 and H1 is 30/38. Other steps stay the same.
styleguide.spacingHint: Multiples of 4. Page margin is 20px on phones and 32px on desktop.
styleguide.radiusHint: Corners follow hierarchy: the larger the thing, the rounder.

control.name: Control
control.use: Anything you tap or type in

styleguide.shadowHint: Only two shadows. Dark mode uses borders instead.
styleguide.motionHint: Four durations, one curve. Reduced motion turns effects almost off.
